title: Blog post card
brief:
An Open Graph image for a blog post, 1200×630 px, as a PNG.

- Background #0f172a, 72px padding on every side.
- Fonts: Inter (regular and bold), in fonts/.
- Top row: the Orbit logo, assets/orbit-logo-white.png (a 252×128 file), shown 126px wide on the left; on the right, a pill "ENGINEERING": Inter bold, 20px, letter spacing 2px, white text on #2563eb, fully rounded, 8px × 16px padding.
- Title: "How we cut our build times in half with incremental bundling": Inter bold, 60px, #ffffff, line height 1.15, left-aligned, at most 2 lines.
- At the bottom of the card: the author's photo, assets/avatar-maya.png (a 256×256 file), shown 64×64 and round; beside it, stacked, "Maya Chen" (Inter bold, 28px, #ffffff) and "June 12, 2027 · 8 min read" (Inter regular, 24px, #94a3b8).

texts.text: How we cut our build times in half with incremental bundling
